leitura.texto:
From: Paula (HR)
To: All production staff
Subject: Changes in November

Hi everyone,
Next month is going to be very busy. On November 4th, the company is installing two new robots on line 1. Because of that, line 1 isn't going to work on the 4th and 5th. Operators from line 1 are going to help on line 2 on those days. There's going to be a training session on the new robots on November 8th, from 2 to 5 p.m., in meeting room B. Everybody from line 1 needs to come. Also, we're having our end-of-year party on December 13th at the Green Garden restaurant. Would you like to bring your family? Please answer by November 20th.
Thanks,
Paula

perguntas.enunciado: How many robots are they installing?
What are line 1 operators going to do on the 4th and 5th?
Who needs to go to the training?
When do people need to answer about the party?

falas.en: Hi, Lia! Are you doing anything on Saturday night?
falas.pt: Oi, Lia! Você vai fazer alguma coisa no sábado à noite?

falas.en: Hmm, I'm having dinner with my parents. Why?
falas.pt: Hmm, vou jantar com meus pais. Por quê?

falas.en: We're going to watch the final at my house. Would you like to come?
falas.pt: Vamos ver a final na minha casa. Quer vir?

falas.en: Oh, I'd love to, but I can't on Saturday. What time does the game start?
falas.pt: Ah, eu adoraria, mas sábado não posso. Que horas começa o jogo?

falas.en: At eight. How about the next game, on Wednesday?
falas.pt: Às oito. Que tal o próximo jogo, na quarta?

falas.en: Wednesday is perfect. Can I bring something?
falas.pt: Quarta é perfeito. Posso levar algo?

falas.en: Bring some snacks. See you on Wednesday!

What is Davi going to do on Saturday?

escrita.instrucao_pt: Escreva seus planos para o próximo mês: 2 planos com going to e 1 compromisso marcado (present continuous + data).
Escreva uma mensagem convidando um amigo para algo, sugerindo dia, hora e lugar.

fala.pergunta_en: What are you going to do next weekend and next vacation?
fala.instrucao_pt: Fale em voz alta seus planos usando going to.

fala.pergunta_en: What would you like to do in five years? Tell me your dreams.
fala.instrucao_pt: Fale em voz alta seus desejos e sonhos (I'd like to, I hope to, maybe).

foco_avaliacao: Nível A2. Going to para planos e intenções (afirmativa, negativa, pergunta), present continuous para compromissos marcados, convites (Would you like to…?, I'd love to, Sorry I can't, How about…?), planos de trabalho, desejos (I'd like to, I hope to).
